text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E in profitable increments has felt rewarding, but I should not let the pleasure of locking in gains replace a clear view of its future prospects.","Selling Stock A after substantial gains reduced my exposure; I should balance that discipline against the risk of cutting promising positions too early.","My account value rose overall despite a dip in Period 3, reminding me to judge decisions across the whole portfolio and over time, not by each month or each stock in isolation."]}
